In [[Japanese cuisine]], '''chankonabe''' ({{langx|ja|ちゃんこ鍋}}), also known as '''chanko''' or '''sumo stew''', is a [[stew]] (a type of {{lang|ja-Latn|[[nabemono]]}} or one-pot dish) commonly eaten in vast quantities by [[sumo]] wrestlers while trying to gain weight.<ref name="japantimes">{{cite web|last=Itoh|first=Makiko|url=https://www.japantimes.co.jp/life/2023/01/08/food/japanese-kitchen-recipe-chanko-nabe/|title=Recipe: Sumo hot pot|newspaper=[[The Japan Times]]|place=[[Tokyo]]|date=2023-01-08|access-date=19 May 2026}}</ref>
